notes.platform_scope: Mobbin indexes iOS and web (plus marketing site sections). Native macOS-only apps are largely absent from the catalog.
notes.substitution_policy: Where a named app is not on Mobbin, closest indexed analogs are included and tagged with requested_apps_proxied_for.
notes.title_policy: Mobbin MCP does not return official screen titles; screen_title values are descriptive titles derived from visible UI chrome / section headlines.

categories.name: Screen-recorder / capture tools
categories.intent: Capture flows, floating toolbars, post-record overlays

references.screen_title: Canvas capture setup with Start Recording panel
references.demonstrates: Pre-record floating panel (source/camera/mic toggles) + canvas background picker + dual pill control bars for stop/pause and layout tools.

references.screen_title: Recording setup panel over Community feed
references.demonstrates: Compact vertical capture launcher with On/Off device states, orange Start Recording CTA, and dark floating session toolbar.
Destructive post-capture decision modal (Restart / Resume / Cancel recording) with educational footer tip about Rewind.
Immediate trim modal after capture: player + waveform handle + Fit waveform zoom + Exit/Trim actions over blurred library.
Post-record editor rhythm: Split/Delete/Add clip, duration delta (e.g. 3:04→2:45), transcript edit entry, Save and exit CTA.

references.screen_title: My Library — recording settings + floating controls
references.demonstrates: Settings popover (video quality Auto/720p/1080p + countdown/controls toggles) paired with always-visible capture pill bar.

references.screen_title: Team Introduction — playback with transcript correct overlay
references.demonstrates: Post-record consumption surface: reactions, AI summary, transcript edit popover (Correct/Delete word), and mobile download banner CTA.
Post-record share panel with segmented Audio/Timeline/Transcript/Subtitles tabs, destination/access dropdowns, Published state, and Copy link.
Pre-record stage: 1080p badge, blur/background preset grid, floating mic/camera/screen-share bar, and red Record CTA.
Post-capture export overlay with Video/Audio tabs, 4K quality dropdown, processing toggles, and Export video CTA over timeline.

categories.name: macOS menu-bar apps — dropdown layouts & separator discipline
categories.intent: Compact dropdowns, grouped actions, hairline separators, destructive isolation

references.demonstrates: Classic menu-bar-like account menu: header identity, icon+label rows, hairline separators between Activity / Commerce / System groups, Sign out last.

references.screen_title: Profile menu with Pause notifications flyout
references.demonstrates: Anchored profile popover + nested DND flyout (status header → Resume / Adjust time / schedule). Strong separator and cascade discipline for utility menus.

references.screen_title: Profile menu — Pause notifications On cascade
references.demonstrates: Menu item with trailing On > state opening a secondary panel; illustrates active-state disclosure without reopening the parent menu.
Dense utility dropdown: plan badge, Settings/Invite, multi-workspace list, Get Mac/iOS app links, then Help/Trash — clear sectional rhythm.

references.screen_title: Source control — connected account overflow menu
references.demonstrates: Dark compact overflow (Manage / Reauthorize / Disconnect) with icon-leading rows — pattern for hazardous disconnect isolated at bottom.

references.screen_title: Collection overflow — destructive actions in red
references.demonstrates: Meatball menu with safe actions first, then red Stop selling / Delete — separator + color discipline for destructive items.
Card-scoped menu (Switch / Change username / Links / Design / Settings) with Delete isolated in red — portable to menu-bar list rows.

references.screen_title: Action item context menu with metadata header
references.demonstrates: Long action list with gray metadata header band, icon rows, and Delete tinted at bottom — separator discipline via whitespace + color.

categories.name: Codec / settings panes
categories.intent: Codec picker grids, quality/resolution controls, export settings density

references.demonstrates: Compact quality picker (Auto / 1080p / 720p) with helper copy plus behavioral toggles — lightweight codec UX for capture tools.
Advanced pane stacking framerate slider, Resolution, Quality, Compression dropdowns, and full-width Export Video CTA.
Modal codec-adjacent controls: 2160p 4K selector, watermark/noise toggles, Video vs Audio tabs — HandBrake-like option grouping without CLI density.
Format dropdown as codec stand-in (Lossless WAV), Destination Local export, Advanced accordion — FFmpeg-UI-lite pattern.

references.screen_title: Export — Transcript toggles + nested timecode popover
references.demonstrates: Dense toggle grid with nested settings popover (interval, paragraph breaks, offset) — nested pane pattern common in OBS/Resolve.

references.screen_title: AI Creation — model picker + quality grid
references.demonstrates: Codec-picker analog: thumbnail list of engines with feature chips, Unlimited badges, plus 720p/1080p segmented quality and aspect-ratio icon grid.
Frosted settings chip row for technical params (5s, 1080p, Ray2) inside tabbed Describe/Keyframe/Reference flow.
Explicit OBS/FFmpeg handoff: RTMPS URL + masked stream key with copy, software encoding (x264) guidance, Start Streaming CTA.

categories.name: Hero / pricing / download CTA patterns
categories.intent: Hero rhythm, primary/secondary CTA placement, download CTAs

references.screen_title: Marketing homepage hero — product UI below fold
references.demonstrates: Dark hero rhythm: brand + nav, single Sign up pill CTA top-right, large headline/subhead, product UI as primary visual (no cluttered first-viewport cards).
Linear pricing rhythm — plan comparison with clear CTA hierarchy matching marketing typography.
Secondary pricing narrative block reinforcing plan CTAs and whitespace discipline.

references.screen_title: Homepage hero — Start Deploying / Get a Demo
references.demonstrates: Centered dual-CTA pattern: solid primary Start Deploying vs outline Get a Demo under short value prop.

references.screen_title: Homepage hero — Contact Sales / Explore the Product
references.demonstrates: Asymmetric hero: bold left headline, right copy+CTAs, metric trust strip directly under fold.
Repeated primary/secondary CTA rhythm below feature grid — conversion without reloading hero.

references.screen_title: Homepage hero — Start a project / See documentation
references.demonstrates: Dark split hero with green primary CTA, ghost docs CTA, and nav-level Start your project duplication.
Desktop-download CTA pattern (Mac/Windows) — closest Mobbin analog to Raycast-style download heroes.
Single-platform Download for Mac button as primary conversion — menu-bar/desktop product marketing pattern.
Premium desktop download CTA with supporting copy — hero-to-install conversion for power-user tools.

categories.name: Open-source / free / MIT framing
categories.intent: License badge rhythm, GitHub star CTAs, free/OSS program framing

references.demonstrates: Open Source as first words of H1, Star us on GitHub in nav, green Start a project CTA — OSS identity as hero-level signal.

references.screen_title: Join one of the world's fastest growing open source communities
references.demonstrates: Community metrics grid (developers, GitHub stars, Twitter, Discord) + logo cloud — social proof via OSS community size.
Mission copy underlining open source with GitHub star CTA retained in chrome — values framing beyond product features.

references.screen_title: Free for OSS projects (MIT / Apache / GPL)
references.demonstrates: Explicit license badge rhythm: [ OPEN SOURCE ] label, MIT/Apache/GPL copy, Apply for OSS CTA beside startup discount card.

references.screen_title: Best practices when using our badge
references.demonstrates: Attribution badge grid (outlined light/dark preferred vs filled) + Download badges — license/badge rhythm pattern for third-party credit.

references.screen_title: Open-weight AI models accessible via API
references.demonstrates: Open-weight model cards (Llama, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS, Qwen) with logos — OSS model framing adjacent to Ollama-style catalogs.

references.screen_title: Pricing models table with Free models accordion
references.demonstrates: Free models called out as a dedicated accordion under paid API table — free tier framing without burying it in fine print.

references.screen_title: Hero — only open source AI-native BI
references.demonstrates: Open source in primary subhead + Start for free / Try live demo dual CTAs — Plausible/Cal.com-like OSS+free conversion stack.

references.screen_title: Our story so far — first GitHub commit timeline
references.demonstrates: Credibility via open-source origin story (first GitHub commit, HN launch) — narrative license/community framing.
Privacy-first analytics positioning closest to Plausible’s free/privacy framing on Mobbin.
